deck: COMMISSION SPLITS, CLOSE RATES, FEE LADDERS, AND BUYER SCREENS TESTED ON LIVE DEALS
LICENSED BROKERAGES, OFF-MARKET PIPELINES, AND PROTECTED CLOSINGS BUILT FROM THE GROUND UP
site_ui.lead: From $3K-$25K coaching offers closed over Zoom to double Lehman M&A mandates, yacht and aircraft listings, and tax-credit transfers, practitioners show how intermediaries source, protect, value, and collect on high-ticket deals.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, each claim carrying timestamped inline attribution to its source video. Together they cover the path from remote commission closing and intermediary role selection through registration, NDAs, valuation, specialist markets, and certainty at closing.
chapters: High-Ticket Sales: From First Offer to Repeatable Closings
Choosing Your Role: Business Broker, M&A Advisor, or Investment Banker
Yacht and Aircraft Brokerage: Entry, Sourcing, and Economics
Protecting Commissions and Collecting at Closing
Business Valuation: Earnings, Multiples, and Deal Structure
Specialist Markets: Digital Businesses, Infrastructure, and Tax Credits
From Deal Presentation to Diligence and Closing Certainty
flow: Match deal size to buyer pool: Main Street brokers sell owner-operated companies to individuals, M&A advisors run auctions above roughly $5M in value, and bankers enter near $100M.
Clear broker-dealer registration or M&A exemptions, along with licensing and supervision controls, before taking mandates.
Run high-volume outreach such as 100 DMs a day and 60-second Looms, and track every lead in a managed deal pipeline.
Sign NDAs and non-circumvention agreements, then screen buyers for cash on hand, backing, and the experience to actually complete.
Never quote a price before seeing the returns: build the credit memo, run DSCR, and apply earnings multiples to the deal structure.
Carry the deal from presentation through diligence to closing certainty, and collect success fees and commissions at closing.
